questions.explanation: From the left the only order fitting all clues is D, E, A, B, C, so C sits at the end opposite D.
questions.q: Five friends A, B, C, D and E sit in a row. A sits next to B but not next to C. D sits at one end. E sits between A and D. Who sits at the other end?
